basic_details.job_title: DIAT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Senior Research Fellow, Junior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Applied Mathematics at the Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT), Girinagar, Pune, has one Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post and one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post. Both are for a DRDO-sponsored research project. The monthly stipend is ₹42,000 for the SRF and ₹37,000 for the JRF, plus 30% HRA. Each post is purely temporary for 06 months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice prints 2 vacancies, one for each post. It advertises them as "SRF OR JRF" and says that if an SRF is not recruited, a JRF may be recruited. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The disciplines are the same for both posts: Data Science/AI/Machine Learning/Modelling & Simulation/CSE/IT/Electronics/Electronics & Communication Engg. Knowledge of Deep Learning, Data Mining, times Series Analysis, Digital Signal Processing/Machine Learning/Python programming/Thermal Image Processing/Deep Learning. Knowledge of python libraries scikit-learn, pytorch, transformers, keras, tensorflow, tkinter etc. and ML algorithms. Qualifications and experience must come from recognised Universities/Institutions/Industries. The prescribed educational qualification is the bare minimum. Having it does not mean a candidate will be considered at every stage of selection. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification. The crucial date for the upper age limit is 9 November 2026.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in First Division with NET/GATE, OR BS-MS/M.E./M.Tech. with First Division both at Graduate & Post Graduate level
rows.experience: A minimum of 02 years of research/teaching/industrial experience in the relevant fields (mandatory)

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in First Division with NET/GATE, OR M.E./M.Tech. with First Division both at Graduate & Post Graduate level

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Besides the monthly stipend, fellows get medical facilities, limited to MI Room facilities. Fellows who are recruited will be encouraged to register for a Ph.D. at DIAT through proper channels, as per DIAT norms. Being offered the SRF or JRF position gives no right to absorption in DIAT (DU), Pune.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DIAT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications go by email to the Principal Investigator. The documents listed below must be sent together as one PDF file, on or before 9 November 2026. Get the application form, which the notice says is "available on the website". Put the documents named in the notice (listed below) into a single PDF file. Email the file to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] . Use this subject line: "Application for SRF or JRF". A brief bio-data, duly signed Application form Proof of Date of Birth BE./B.Tech M.E/M.Tech mark sheets and degree certificates Mention all your qualifications and experience clearly in the application, with supporting documents. Shortlisting may depend on qualifications and experience above the minimum.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be called for an interview based on their suitability for the project.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The selected candidate must join duty immediately on receiving the offer letter. For further details or clarification, contact Dr. Yogeshwar Singh Dadwhal, PI, Department of Applied Mathematics, on Telephone No. (020) 2460 4472/4588 or Mob.: +917696615848.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice prints 2 vacancies: 01 Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and 01 Junior Research Fellow (JRF). It advertises them as "SRF OR JRF", and a JRF may be recruited if an SRF is not.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DIAT SRF/JRF posts?
faq.answer: Send your application by email on or before 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DIAT JRF post?
faq.answer: You need B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in Data Science/AI/Machine Learning/Modelling & Simulation/CSE/IT/Electronics/Electronics & Communication Engg. in First Division with NET/GATE. Alternatively, you need M.E./M.Tech. in these disciplines with First Division both at Graduate & Post Graduate level.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience does the DIAT SRF post require?
faq.answer: The SRF post requires a minimum of 02 years of research/teaching/industrial experience in the relevant fields. This is in addition to the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DIAT SRF and JRF?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 32 years for the SRF and 28 years for the JRF, as on 9 November 2026. SC/ST, Women and PwBD candidates get up to 05 years of relaxation, and OBC (NCL) candidates get 03 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for DIAT SRF and JRF?
faq.answer: The SRF gets ₹42,000/- plus 30% HRA per month. The JRF gets ₹37,000/- plus 30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA or any other benefit paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: Yes. 30% HRA is paid on top of the stipend. Medical facilities, limited to MI Room facilities, are also provided.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email a signed brief bio-data, the application form, proof of Date of Birth, and your mark sheets and degree certificates as one PDF file to [email protected]. Use the subject "Application for SRF or JRF".

faq.question: Q9. How will DIAT select the SRF/JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their suitability for the project, and the Screening Committee may limit the number called. Shortlisted candidates are informed by email and interviewed in person or by video conference. No TA/DA is paid.

faq.question: Q10. Is the DIAT SRF/JRF position permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary for 06 months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. It gives no right to absorption in DIAT (DU), Pune.
